hook: In 2017, the Deutsche Bundesbank launched a study into its dark past.

sections.voiceover: In 2017, the Deutsche Bundesbank launched a study into its dark past.
b_roll: Archives of the Deutsche Bundesbank in Frankfurt
Historical documents on a wooden desk

sections.voiceover: Historian Magnus Brechtken investigated the roots of the Reichsbank from 1924 to 1970. Bloomberg revealed the institution played a crucial role in Hitler's Germany. What did academics uncover about the Reichsbank?
b_roll: Historical Reichsbank building facade in Berlin

sections.voiceover: Bloomberg revealed the findings, but the study didn't stop there.
Professor Magnus Brechtken's team published one hundred pages on the early Bundesbank.
b_roll: Modern Bloomberg terminal screen showing archives

sections.voiceover: Read the Bloomberg report to see how the Reichsbank operated under Hitler.
b_roll: Deutsche Bundesbank official seal on paper
